_comment: Example event-type catalog: maps an event_type to a warehouse table + its columns. Replace with your own schema, or point SURVEY_EVENT_TYPES at your own catalog file. time_field is used for windowing; duration_field (if any) for time-spent aggregates; id_field (optional) names the respondent-id column (default respondent_id, or SURVEY_ENRICH_ID_FIELD). When `fields` is listed, compiled SQL only accepts those columns (plus the time/duration/id fields).
